method.distance: equal-weight mixed Gower on three original responses

decision.exclusion_reason: Final researcher scope decision: retain only the multidimensional employment-security/formality clustering; this solution is primarily a direct hours/income-preference segmentation.
decision.status: Excluded from the final Branch F dimension set despite statistical stability

limitations: These are exploratory earnings/working-time response profiles, not a validated employment-adequacy scale.
Hours/income preference is nominal; no numeric desirability order is imposed.
Usual weekly hours are self-reported and do not by themselves identify overwork or underemployment.
Job satisfaction and actual hours describe profiles but do not determine distance.
The result is driven mainly by hours/income preference: omitting that feature changes the partition substantially, so this is not evidence of two broad earnings levels.
The one routing-corrupted final-Branch-F record is excluded from this employment analysis.
Final framework decision: keep this result only as a descriptive diagnostic; it is not part of the retained Branch F clustering set.
